initial-dialogue-after-finishing-icthlar.text: If the player does not have a ghostspeak amulet equipped:

steps.text: The spirit tries to converse with you, but you can't understand him.

initial-dialogue-after-finishing-icthlar.npc: Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.

initial-dialogue-after-finishing-icthlar.player: Wait! I want to ask you a question...

initial-dialogue-after-finishing-icthlar.text: Klenter disappears before you can ask him anything.
